payload.task_text:
I need to prepare a category performance review presentation for our e-commerce store. Please pull product data from the online store and analyze performance by product category. For each category, calculate the number of products, the average price, the total units sold across all products in that category, and the average customer rating.

Create an Excel workbook called Category_Data.xlsx in the workspace with a sheet named "Category Performance" containing columns for Category, Product_Count, Avg_Price, Total_Units_Sold, and Avg_Rating. Sort the rows alphabetically by category name.

Then create a PowerPoint presentation called Category_Review.pptx in the workspace. The first slide should be a title slide with the title "Product Category Performance Review". After that, create one slide for each product category showing the category name as the slide title and the key metrics (number of products, average price, total units sold, and average rating) in the slide content. Finally, add a summary slide at the end titled "Overall Summary" that highlights the category with the most products, the category with the highest average rating, and the category with the most total units sold.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent and dispatch no sub-agent. Call `woo_products_list(page=1, perPage=100)` and continue only if the response exposes another page; require the verified 82 unique product IDs. Preserve every category membership, numeric current price, `total_sales`, and `average_rating`. Include multi-category products in every listed category. For each observed category calculate Product_Count, arithmetic Avg_Price with missing/empty price as zero, sum Total_Units_Sold with missing as zero, and arithmetic Avg_Rating over positive numeric ratings only; round averages to two decimals and retain raw denominators. Sort categories alphabetically and surface deterministic ties for most products, highest rating, and most sold.

Freeze one canonical category table. The main agent is sole writer of `Category_Data.xlsx` with exact sheet `Category Performance`, exact headers, literal rows, and full readback. It also owns one `Category_Review.pptx` presentation ID with title slide, exactly one slide per category, and final `Overall Summary` using the same tie-resolved highlights. Interleave independent workbook and presentation calls after the table is frozen; read back the populated Excel range, slide count/titles, and every displayed metric, then finish without a Wave or repair agent.

nodes.text:
Pull all WooCommerce products and product categories, handling pagination (up to 100 per page) until complete. Compute one row per category, alphabetically sorted, with: Category, Product_Count, Avg_Price, Total_Units_Sold, Avg_Rating. Use product price as numeric current price (fall back to regular_price only if needed), total_sales for units sold, and average_rating for ratings. Products assigned to multiple categories should count in each assigned category. Exclude uncategorized only if it is not returned as an assigned category; otherwise treat it like any category. Report raw product/category coverage, formulas/assumptions, precise aggregate values, tie handling candidates for maxima, and enough detail for an artifact builder to reproduce the workbook and presentation. Read-only task; do not create files.
Analyze category performance

Create and verify two polished artifacts inside ONLY this workspace: /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_gpt-5.6-sol/SingleUserTurn-wc-category-performance-ppt/workspace

1) Category_Data.xlsx with exactly one required sheet named "Category Performance". Columns, in order: Category, Product_Count, Avg_Price, Total_Units_Sold, Avg_Rating. Rows alphabetically sorted:

Keep underlying precision. Format as a professional Excel table with clear header, sensible column widths, frozen header if supported; Avg_Price as currency with 2 decimals, Avg_Rating with 3 decimals, counts/units as integers. Verify by reading the finished workbook.

2) Category_Review.pptx. Create 10 slides total: title slide titled exactly "Product Category Performance Review"; then one slide for each of the 8 categories in the same alphabetical order; then final slide titled exactly "Overall Summary". Each category slide must clearly show category name as title and the four metrics: number of products, average price, total units sold, average rating. Display price to 2 decimals, rating to 3 decimals, units with thousands separators. Make it clean, professional, and visually consistent (e.g. modern blue/corporate theme, metric cards or concise layout), with no clipping/overlap. Summary must highlight: most products = Electronics (30); highest average rating = TV & Home Theater (4.782); most total units sold = Electronics (2,987). Optional secondary callout: TV & Home Theater has highest avg price ($304.90), but do not distract from required three. Verify slide count and extract text from finished presentation to ensure all titles/metrics exist.

Return exact output paths and verification results. Do not modify external systems.
Build workbook and presentation
